note: Coverage ratchet floor for the mutation gate. The gate targets the self-contained civ-save-db crate (no internal path deps) which completes a real baseline in ~14s and yields a measurable kill rate. The gate passes only if the run's kill rate is AT OR ABOVE the recorded floor. Raise 'floor' by opening a PR that bumps it after coverage improves; it may then only move upward (monotonic).
